description: Call when a check reports the frame over budget or the user asks about performance (stutter, low fps, a phone target): measures frame time, draw calls, triangles and asset size of the open page against a budget (desktop by default, or the contract's). To find what costs the frame, give `variants`: each is measured on a fresh page against the baseline, in this one call, with named objects hidden, a pixel ratio, code run with `renderer` and `scene` (shadows or antialias off, a material swapped), or a `query` the page loads with ("noshadow&pr=0.5", for switches the game reads at load); no reopening or reload code needed.

budget.description: desktop, mobile, quest, or limits to override: { frameMs, assetMB, triangles, textureMax, pixelRatioMax }.

name: game_perf
